headline: Anthropic Moves Toward IPO as Broader AI Market Hesitates
summary: Anthropic is preparing an initial public offering even as wider market jitters sideline public listings across the artificial intelligence sector.
why: Anthropic, developer of the Claude model family, is among the world's most heavily funded private generative AI foundation model providers.

impacts.name: Software - Infrastructure
impacts.why: A successful public debut by a premier frontier AI lab establishes public equity valuation metrics for foundational AI developers.
